Start date: 1510-11-19  
Add 48 weeks = 336 days.  
Add 2 days = total 338 days.  

1510-11-19 + 338 days:  
November 1510 has 30 days → from Nov 19 to Nov 30 = 11 days.  
December 1510 has 31 days → total 42 days used, remaining 296 days.  
1511 is not a leap year (not divisible by 4) → 365 days.  
296 days into 1511:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30 → total 273 days by end of September.  
296 - 273 = 23 days into October → 1511-10-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1511-10-23
